sync.title: The Fifth Transformation Wave
sync.rawTitle: #2 - Albert Esplugas: The Fifth Transformation Wave | Leading in AI Podcast
sync.youtubeDescription:
Albert Esplugas is CEO of Futuria Strategy. He has over 30 years of experience in technology, innovation, and digital transformation, 12 of which he spent at Microsoft and Amazon headquarters in Seattle. He's also been a professor at ESADE and recently published a book on AI written in collaboration with AI itself. Albert has lived through five technology waves—PC, internet, mobile, cloud, and now AI—and he says this one is the biggest.
In this episode, we talk about why AI democratizes intelligence itself, how companies can move from scattered proof of concepts to coherent AI strategy, and why AI should amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it.

Topics covered:
- Why AI is different from PC, internet, mobile, and cloud
- The three-year window: from experimentation to execution
- How to connect AI strategy to business strategy
- Why human ingenuity will grow with AI, not shrink
- How agents will connect the dots across organizations

Connect with Albert Esplugas: https://www.linkedin.com/in/albertesplugas/

About Leading in AI:
Leading in AI is a weekly podcast featuring conversations with professionals, founders, and academics who are building, deploying, and thinking critically about AI in their organizations.
